INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished editorial thumbnail for the Japanese independent basketball site バスケまとめ. Landscape PNG, 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864 pixels or larger. This is a NEW hand-drawn illustration, not a photograph, not a collage.

Source content is frozen: Kawasaki Brave Thunders went 3 wins and 2 losses in their last five games, November 9 through November 18, 2026, and are on a three-game winning streak. The article describes offensive rebounding and free throws as the team's strengths. Do not add individual statistics, rankings, or factual claims.

Visual style: Match the approved black-and-lime editorial reference already viewed: deep near-black #151A18 background, bold warm ivory Japanese typography, acid lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush strokes and a little ink splatter, hand-drawn sports ink illustration with decisive black shadows and ivory hatchwork. Spacious and minimal, strong mobile legibility. Do not copy the previous thumbnail's athlete, name, numbers, date, or exact composition.

Subject: Exactly one real player, Matt Bonds, randomly selected from the article's three named players. His name must NOT appear in the image. Draw his actual likeness based on the official Kawasaki profile portrait viewed: broad rounded voluminous black afro with slightly squared upper mass; medium-dark warm brown skin rendered as ink/ivory tonal illustration; oval face narrowing to chin; full lips; medium broad straight nose; dark almond-shaped eyes; short connected moustache and dark beard with a fuller pointed chin section; strong shoulders and muscular athletic arms. Keep these distinctive facial traits. Not a generic imaginary athlete, not the short-haired player from the style example. He wears a plain basketball singlet with no lettering, number, emblem, sponsor, team logo, or league logo. Do not paste any official photograph.

Composition: Put the player on the LEFT 42 percent, dynamically twisting and gathering an orange basketball with BOTH HANDS just above the left side of his head, as a conceptual rebound action. Face visible in a near-front three-quarter view, eyes toward the ball. Each hand has five anatomically correct fingers naturally wrapping the ball. All head, afro, fingers, elbows and ball stay inside the canvas with safe margins. Crop deliberately at upper thighs near the bottom edge, if needed. Brush strokes provide movement behind the athlete without crossing or obscuring the text. No additional players, no crowd, no arena details, no opponent, no scoreboard. This is an illustrative concept, NOT a recreation of an actual play or a particular match.

Text layout RIGHT 52 percent, aligned left in clean generous rows. Use accurate bold Japanese sans-serif lettering, no garbled or added characters. Important headline large and right-side textual block never overlaps the player's hands or head. The team name and result must clearly read as team-level, never as the selected player's achievement.
Text (verbatim), exactly these strings:
small masthead: "バスケまとめ"
small contextual line: "直近5試合 3勝2敗"
headline first row in ivory: "川崎"
headline second row, largest lime lettering: "3連勝"

"オフェンスリバウンドと"
"フリースローが支える"
small bottom line with readable comfortable spacing: "対象：11/9〜11/18"
footer safely inset from lower edge, unobstructed: "イラスト（AI生成）   イメージ"

Do not write the player's name or personal performance anywhere. No logos, no watermarks, no official photos, no photorealism. Preserve the AI-generated label exactly. Crisp polished composition with generous edges and a calm text area.

ONE PERMITTED REVISION
Edit the provided generated basketball thumbnail. Make ONE targeted layout correction only: move the entire illustrated athlete and basketball assembly downward enough that the very top of the ball has at least 35 pixels (about 4% canvas height) of clear dark background above it. Slightly reduce the left-side figure by about 5% only if needed so that the whole ball, afro, fingers, and both elbows stay inside the image; deliberate lower torso cropping at bottom is fine. Preserve the real Matt Bonds facial likeness, afro, beard, hands, pose, ink illustration treatment, background, colors, all right-side text positions, type sizes, wording, AI label and other design exactly. Keep the output 1672 x 941 or equivalent 16:9 landscape at least 1000px wide. No added words, logos, photographic elements or players.
